text:
Aditi: ok team — we need a compact dependency map + launch criteria for the new customer onramp pilot. customer wants private deploy + reserved capacity + HSM. can we surface hard blockers by EOD?
Sam: short answer: runtime + infra both have items. runtime needs quantization profile & batching plan; infra needs network/topology + KMS certs.
Rafael: runtime note — we can support their model but need a 2-week kernel validation for mixed-precision on our 80B flow. that affects canary timing.
Priya: infra note — private deploy requires VPC peering + customer routing rules. Networking windows are limited next sprint. also need HSM account provisioning (depends on security).
Noah: security: HSM/KMS approval, threat model, and audit log retention policy. I need the exact list of secrets and who rotates keys. put them in a doc or I can't sign off.
Marta: from platform side — feature flag gating + rollout lanes (canary -> 25% -> 100%) and observability hooks. I can add token-level cost dashboards but need model variant names and expected qps.
Aditi: good. concrete asks: Rafael = quant profile timeline; Priya = networking & prewarm ops timeline; Noah = explicit key rotation doc; Marta = rollout lanes + dashboard hooks. Sam, can you align runtime infra deps and propose a launch date window?
Sam: yes. quick sketch: 3 sprints if we parallelize HSM onboarding + kernel validation. timeline: sprint A (HSM onboarding + network prep), sprint B (kernel validation + prewarm + feature flags), sprint C (canary + metrics/runbook).
Rafael: FYI we'll need a short eval set from the customer to validate quality after quant. please request ASAP.
Priya: noted. also flag: if they require onprem HSM, procurement lead time is 6 weeks. that pushes to 5 sprints unless they accept cloud HSM.
Noah: @Priya can you confirm which HSM vendor? cloud vs onprem changes audit requirements.
Priya: talking to procurement now. ETA 24h.
Marta: I'll stub dashboards and a rollout checklist doc by EOD. can someone add expected qps and token distribution?
Aditi: Rafael — can you estimate qps assumptions for quant sim by tomorrow morning?
Rafael: yes, I can run sims overnight.
Sam: I'll merge a simple dep map in the repo: repo.redwood/internal/onramp/dep_map.md and ping infra/runtime owners.
ci-bot: deploy-bot: New branch created: feature/onramp-dep-map by Sam — build queued.
Aditi: sweet. final ask — list top-3 non-negotiable launch criteria (security signoff, kernel validation, network path verified). add anything else and I'll consolidate for the customer checklist.
Noah: +1 to those three. also require audit log exports to S3 or equivalent (retention 90d).
Priya: include prewarm test: 10k tokens/sec sustained for 5min in staging.
Marta: include SLA smoke: <300ms median tail in canary.
Aditi: perfect. I'll synthesize and post a short checklist. thanks everyone — update your cards. :thumbsup:
